translator_notes: This page lists recommended companion books to Durov's Code
Sarah Lacy's book is about young tech entrepreneurs globally
'Even Nerds Do Business' by Maxim Kotin is about Fyodor Ovchinnikov, another Russian tech entrepreneur
The word 'ботаники' (nerds/botanists) ties into the book's theme of nerds building tech empires
